# Nexus-MCP

> Unified, local-first MCP server combining hybrid search (vector + BM25 + graph), structural code graph analysis, and persistent semantic memory in a single process. Designed for AI coding agents via the Model Context Protocol. about 90MB RAM idle and 460MB with the embedding model loaded, no API keys, no cloud dependencies. Source-available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

Nexus-MCP gives AI agents precise, token-efficient code understanding. It indexes codebases into three engines (vector embeddings, BM25 keyword index, rustworkx code graph) and fuses results via Reciprocal Rank Fusion with FlashRank re-ranking. Agents get the code they need in 500-2000 tokens instead of reading entire files (5000-15000 tokens). Supports 25+ programming languages via dual parsing (tree-sitter + ast-grep).

## Core Tools (10 MCP tools)

- [index](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Index one or more folders — parallel parsing, incremental reindex on changed files, 8-step pipeline. Starts a file watcher for auto-reindex.
- [status](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Index stats, memory usage, and a staleness warning when files changed since the last index.
- [health](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Liveness/readiness probe.
- [search](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Hybrid code search — vector semantic + BM25 keyword + graph structural, fused via RRF, re-ranked with FlashRank. Language/type filters, live-grep fallback.
- [find_symbol](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Look up a symbol by name — definition, location, relationships. Exact or fuzzy matching.
- [graph](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Callers or callees of a symbol; `transitive=True` for change-impact analysis. Replaces find_callers, find_callees and impact. Call edges are static and name-based, so results are a lower bound.
- [explain](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Combined graph + semantic + metrics explanation of a symbol, with `verbosity` summary/detailed/full.
- [analyze](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Code complexity, dependencies, smells, and quality metrics.
- [map](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Project overview (`detail="summary"`), architecture (`"architecture"`), or both (`"full"`). Replaces overview and architecture.
- [memory](https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/main/docs/USAGE_GUIDE.md): `action="store"`/`"search"`/`"delete"` — persist and retrieve project context with tags and TTL. Replaces remember, recall and forget.

## Install

- PyPI: `pip install nexus-mcp-ci` (or `pip install nexus-mcp-ci[gpu,reranker]` for all extras)
- From source: `git clone https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP && cd Nexus-MCP && ./setup.sh`
- Add to Claude Code: `claude mcp add nexus-mcp -- nexus-mcp-ci`

## Key Technical Details

- **Search pipeline**: query -> [vector, BM25] -> source files before test files -> RRF fusion (weights 0.5/0.3; the graph list is off by default) -> FlashRank re-rank (only if `flashrank` is installed) -> token budget truncation
- **Storage**: LanceDB (vectors + FTS, mmap disk-backed), SQLite (graph persistence), no ChromaDB
- **Embedding**: bge-small-en-v1.5 default (384d); jina-code is deprecated
- **Graph**: rustworkx PyDiGraph — containment, import and static call edges; caller/callee and impact traversal
- **Parsing**: tree-sitter (symbol extraction for embeddings) + ast-grep (containment and import structure for the graph)
- **Memory**: LanceDB-backed semantic memory with 6 types, TTL expiration, tag filtering
- **Token budgets**: responses are truncated to a token budget; `explain` takes a `verbosity` of summary (~500 tok), detailed (~2000 tok) or full (~8000 tok)
